title: Possible {name} in source
description: A string shaped like {name} was found in source. Anyone with repository access can try it until it is revoked. Shape-only: this does not prove the credential is live.
remediation: Revoke the value in the provider console, audit its use, and replace it with a minimally scoped credential stored outside version control.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the documented prefix and length family, which cannot prove a live credential.
fp: Documentation and redacted examples using the same prefix are the common false positives.
recordDesc: {name} credentials start a fixed prefix followed by a random run. Committed tokens grant their scopes to every reader until revoked.
risk: Account and service takeover with the token's scopes; HIGH severity.
why: {name} values committed in source work for anyone holding them until revoked.
fix: Audit actions it performed and remediate misuse.
Issue a minimal-scope replacement from a secret manager.
verifyT: The old value no longer authenticates, and no shaped literal remains committed.
